auth:
FILES: none of them need API auth. The user downloads each file after logging in.
- KIS HTS eFriend Pro [7451]: pick the account and enter the account password (from the HTS help text, which also shows 비밀번호 on screen). KIS homepage: My page > 계좌별 거래내역, after login. The help popup says only accounts with an 인터넷뱅킹 약정 can be queried.
- Toss: issued in the app only. Path per support.toss.im/faq/3331: 토스증권 홈 > 우측 상단 회색 삼단바 > 설정 > 계좌관리 > '증명서 발급하기'; the phone needs a PDF app. The earlier claim that it is shared "via email/messenger" is NOT in the FAQ, so I removed it.
- Hana: personal-banking login required. Pension URLs redirect to a login page offering 하나인증서, 공동/금융인증서, 아이디 and 하나원큐인증 (checked in the browser).

KB OpenAPI (only for SWQA2301/SWQM2412). OFFICIAL sources: portal openapi.kbsec.com/guide_b2c, the portal JSON doc zip (/api/kbs/guide/json/b2c: token.json, SWQA2301.json), and the kbsecurities/kb-openapi example/python README and common.py @5120174.
- Token call: POST https://developer.kbsec.com:32484/oauth2/token.
- Token body: {"dataHeader":{"ipAddr":"","macAddr":""},"dataBody":{"appKey":"…","appSecret":"…","grantType":"client_credentials"}}.
- Token response: dataBody.access_token, dataBody.token_type "Bearer", dataBody.expires_in 86400 (seconds, i.e. 24h).
- Discrepancy: the portal guide web page shows a flat body {"grant_type":"client_credentials","appKey","appSecret"}, but the portal JSON doc and the repo both use the wrapped dataHeader/dataBody form with grantType.
- TR headers: Content-Type: application/json; appKey: <appKey>; Authorization: bearer <access_token>. The repo README says lowercase 'bearer'; the portal example shows 'Bearer'.
- Per the portal, token issuance checks appKey, appSecret, API 사용 신청, 앱 사용 가능 여부, API 권한, 계좌 권한, 호출 제한 정책 and 서비스 해지 여부.
- No reissue limit or user-approval step is documented beyond the portal sign-up: KB 계좌 → 홈페이지 Open API 사용신청 → appKey/appSecret 발급.
- Production only: the repo README says there is no sandbox.
account_selection:
- KIS: choose the 계좌번호 on the [7451] screen or homepage and enter the password (HTS). One export per account.
  - Only 인터넷뱅킹-약정 accounts are listed, so the list can differ from 자산현황. This is stated in both the HTS screen note and the homepage help popup.
  - The birdblues/kbtest files are named `<10 digits>-<yyyymmdd>.csv`, consistent with CANO(8)+ACNT_PRDT_CD(2). Whether that is KIS's default file name or the user renamed them is unconfirmed.
  - The repo's notebooks call openapi.koreainvestment.com:9443, which supports reading these as KIS exports.
- Toss: one PDF per account. The header has '계좌 번호' plus issuance options '종목 전체', '원화-외화 거래구분 원화+달러' and '거래구분 전체'.
  - Masking in samples ('***-**-***3201', 'XXX-01-XXXXX') comes from anonymized fixtures, so the real PDF's masking is unconfirmed.
- KB SWQA2301: the current official spec (portal Excel sheet 'SWQA2301_거래내역조회', 최초작성일 2026-09-25) has NO account, product-code or password input. The inputs are only strt_dt, end_dt, is_no, nxt_key and srt_clsf.
  - The portal says token issuance and calls check '계좌 권한', and it tells users to check '사용 계좌 및 계좌 연결 상태' on errors. So the account appears to be bound to the app registration (inference).
  - The unofficial kabdols1-gif/OpenAPI XML lists gnl_ac_no (종합계좌번호, Size 9), gds_no (상품번호, Size 2) and pwd (비밀번호, Size 8), all with SkipValue="Y".
  - jewon-oh/kr-broker (secondary) states "계좌번호를 받는 TR이 없습니다".
- Hana DC: after login, menu 퇴직연금 > 연금계좌 조회 > 퇴직연금 계좌정보 / 운용현황 알아보기 / 입금내역.

Format:

- Dates are 'YYYY.M.D', not zero-padded; all of 9999.9.9, 9999.9.99, 9999.99.9 and 9999.99.99 occur.
- Amounts are quoted strings with commas.

PDF layout:

거래구분 values seen in real (anonymized) PDF text:
- deposit: 이체입금; 이체입금(카카오뱅크), (토스뱅크), (토스증권); '이벤트 입금' (promo credit)
- withdrawal: 이체출금; 이체출금(카카오뱅크), (기업은행); '이체출금 토스페이' (counterparty 토스페이)
- domestic dividend: 배당금입금. 거래대금 = gross, 제세금 = withholding, and 잔액 rises by 거래대금 − 제세금 (7,300 − 1,120 = +6,180, verified 31,269 → 37,449). Tiny dividends can show 제세금 0 (thekanon: 50 and 100 won, tax 0).
- interest: 이자입금, same gross/tax logic (290 − 40 = +250, verified).
- tax: 배당세출금, 외화이자세금출금 (these can post a 변제/연체합 arrear when KRW 잔액 is 0)
- FX legs (internal): 환전원화출금, 환전원화입금
- trades: 구매, 판매
- stock rewards: 1주이벤트입고 (thekanon raw)

endpoints.purpose: 토스증권 거래내역서 PDF, 달러 거래내역 section: USD dividends, US withholding, FX, US trades, stock lending
endpoints.url: Same PDF as the 원화 section (토스증권 > 설정 > 계좌관리 > 증명서 발급하기 > 거래 내역서)
endpoints.request: Same PDF; 원화-외화 거래구분 must include 달러.
endpoints.response_fields:
Layout:
- Section title '달러 거래내역', then '수량단위 : 주, 달러 | 금액단위 : 원, 달러'.
- Column header (no 거래세 column): 거래일자 거래구분 종목명(종목코드) 환율 거래수량 거래대금 단가 수수료 제세금 변제/연체합 잔고 잔액
- Each row spans 2 lines. Line 1 holds KRW-converted values. Line 2 is '($ 거래대금) ($ 단가) ($ 수수료) ($ 제세금) ($ 변제/연체합) ($ 잔액)'. Verified on a buy: 45 × 16.83 = 757.35.
- Long names wrap, so the ISIN can start line 2, e.g. '(US38747R7513) ($ 0.00)…'.

거래구분 values seen in real (anonymized) text:
- dividends: 외화증권배당금입금 (거래수량 = shares held)
- interest: 외화이자입금
- FX legs: 환전외화입금, 환전외화출금, 환전외화입금취소
- trades: 구매, 판매
- stock lending: '대여료 입금', '대차거래 대여출고', '대차거래 상환입고'
- rewards: 소수점이벤트입고 (thekanon)

From parser maps only: 외화배당단주대금입금, 외화배당금취소출금, 외국납부세액출금, 외화세금환급 (TossTypes.java; 외화세금환급 is also in the nogamsung map).

Dividend arithmetic, checked on 5 taxed rows:
- $제세금 / ($거래대금 + $제세금) = 0.150–0.152 every time (0.63/4.21, 0.08/0.53, 4.08/27.17, 0.16/1.05, 2.61/17.39).
- USD 잔액 rises by $거래대금 (1,446.71 + 3.58 = 1,450.29, consecutive rows).
- So $거래대금 = amount credited, net of 15% US withholding; $제세금 = US tax withheld; gross = 거래대금 + 제세금. The nogamsung parser labels $거래대금 as 'gross', and I believe that label is wrong.
- When $제세금 = 0, a same-day KRW '배당세출금' row carries the tax: 3,220 ≈ 15.4% × 20,937.

endpoints.purpose: KB증권 OpenAPI SWQA2301 계좌원장 거래내역 조회 (위탁, 금융상품, 저축): ledger rows with 적요명. The portal describes it as 입출금, 매매, 배당 등 계좌 원장 상의 모든 거래 기록.
headers: appKey: <appKey> (official repo example/python/common.py; not shown in the portal guide's header example)

Body: {"dataHeader":{"ipAddr":"…","macAddr":"…"},"dataBody":{…}}

CURRENT OFFICIAL spec (portal Excel sheet 'SWQA2301_거래내역조회', 최초작성일 2026-09-25, and portal JSON doc SWQA2301.json). dataBody:
- strt_dt: 시작일자, String(8), required, YYYYMMDD
- end_dt: 종료일자, String(8), required
- is_no: 종목번호, String(12), optional
- nxt_key: 다음키, String(100), optional

There are NO account, password or 조회구분 inputs.

OLDER spec (kbsecurities/kb-openapi @159480c, samples.generated.json Tkb_SWQA2301_B2C) had 19 inputs, including:
- inq_clsf (조회구분, required, desc '전체', sample '1')
- inq_clsf1..6 = 입금/출금/입고/출고/매수/매도 (1:설정, 0:미설정)
- strt_no (start from this 거래일련번호)
- dl_clsf ('1:간편거래로 출력'), dl_md_ccd, md_isnc_tno, crdt_crd_isnc_info, onl_prt_ccd, isng_bl_at_trsns_xcl_f
That sample was deleted from the repo in commit a8ac610 '불필요 sample 삭제' (2026-09-15). Current HEAD 5120174 has only the 29 투자정보 samples.

The unofficial kabdols1-gif/OpenAPI Tkb_SWQA2301_B2C.xml additionally lists gnl_ac_no, gds_no and pwd, marked SkipValue="Y".
endpoints.response_fields:
All values are strings. Names and Korean labels are from the official portal Excel and the JSON sample.

Response envelope (dataHeader): resultCode ("200"), resultMessage ("성공"), processFlag, processCode, processMessage, processTime.

dataBody head: o_lngth (출길이), o_clsf (출구분, 'SC' in sample), o_msg (출메시지), nxt_key (다음키), grid_cnt1 (그리드건수1).

Record1 (array, spec 'Object array(12)'):
Ledger and IDs:
- dl_dt (거래일자, YYYYMMDD), dl_sq (거래일련번호)
- smry_nm (적요명, 35), smry_typ_cd (적요유형코드, 3), dl_typ_cd (거래유형코드, 2), dl_mkt (거래시장)

Amounts:
- q (수량), dl_uprc (거래단가), dl_amt (거래금액), ec_amt (정산금액)
- fcrncy_amt (외화금액), exch_r (환율), ocp_pymt_amt (원본납입금), fncng_amt (융자금액), etc_chck_amt (기타수표금액), dl_txtn_uprc (거래과세단가)
Fees and taxes:
- fee (수수료), abrd_fee (국외수수료)
- tx (세금), incm_tx (소득세), rsdnt_tx (주민세), dl_tx (거래세), ffs_tx (농특세), trsf_tx (양도세)
- itst_use_fe (이자이용료)
Balances:
- tfnd_blnc (예수금잔고), fcrncy_tfnd (외화예수금), fcrncy_tfnd_ra (외화예수금잔액)
- scrts_blnc_q (유가증권잔고수량), bnf_blnc_val (수익증권잔고평가), bnf_no (수익증권번호)
Repayments:
- rcvbl_rpay_amt (미수변제금액), itst_rpay_amt (이자변제금액), arrs_fee (연체료), scrts_rpay_q (유가증권변제수량)
- stmt_pr_pymt_amt (결제선납입금액), stmt_pr_pymt_amt_rpay (결제선납입금액변제), etc_lndng_amt_rpay_amt (기타대여금변제금액)

ONLY documented 적요 example (official portal JSON sample): smry_nm '입금' with smry_typ_cd '001' and dl_typ_cd '01'.
The smry_typ_cd and dl_typ_cd code tables are NOT published: the Excel description column is empty.

Number formats in the official sample are mixed:
- dl_amt is right-aligned with commas ('                     1,000,000')
- ec_amt and tfnd_blnc are zero-padded ('000000001000000')
- fcrncy_amt looks like '0000000000000.00', exch_r like '000000.0000'
- q and dl_tx are blank when not applicable
endpoints.pagination: Pass the response nxt_key back in the request. In the official sample, an all-spaces 100-char nxt_key means no more data. Page size is probably 12 (spec 'Object array(12)'; XML Record1 Repeat="12"); that is inferred. The old strt_no input is gone from the current spec. The official repo notes that KB can return HTTP 200 with a business error in the body, so check dataHeader and o_msg.

All SECONDARY.

(1) 2-row header, 2 rows per transaction (doozon process_central_kb docstring):
- Row0: 거래일자, 거래종류, 수량, 거래금액, 정산금액, 거래세등, 소득세, 양도세, 대출금, 유가잔고, 미수변제, 통화구분, 환율, 국외수수료
- Row1: (blank), 종목명, 단가, 수수료, 펀드가입번호, 농특세, 지방소득세, 과세기준가, 신용, 예수금, 연체변제, 외화예수금, (blank), 외화정산금액
- dongorae reads the same file type by header name but spells two columns differently: '거래세 등' and '농특세/부가세'. Also 통화구분 (KRW/USD), 외화정산금액, 예수금, 외화예수금. Match headers loosely (strip spaces).
- dongorae says a newer single-header CSV has the same columns, including 통화구분.

(2) Older single-row CSV (dongorae _map_kb_single): 거래일자, 거래종류, 종목명, 수량, 단가, 거래금액, 정산금액, 거래세, 농특세, 소득세, 주민세. It has no 통화구분; dongorae infers KRW when the type contains '장내'.

(3) Single-row '거래일 | 내용 | 종목 | 수량 | 단가 | 입금 | 출금' layout (doozon process_valuable_kb_sec, positions 0-6). Only the '거래일' and '내용' header names are checked by code.

거래종류 / 내용 strings (KB-specific code only):
- deposits: 은행이체입금 / '은행이체 입금', 대체입금
- withdrawals: 대체출금, 기관납입출금 / '기관납입 출금'
- interest: 예탁금이용료입금 / '예탁금이용료 입금'
- in-kind: 공모주입고 / '공모주 입고', 타사대체출고 / '타사대체', '타사대체 입고', '타사대체 출고'
- fees: 타사대체수수료, 출고수수료
- trades: types containing '장내' (e.g. 장내매수/장내매도), plus '매수' and '매도'
- FX: 외화매수, 외화매도, anything containing '환전' (one row carries both KRW and FX legs)
- Dividends: dongorae only matches the substring '배당'. An exact KB dividend string (e.g. 배당금입금) is NOT confirmed.
- Names can carry an _OLD/_NEW suffix (dongorae _kb_name).

Legal minimum content (PRIMARY, law.go.kr, rendered):
- 근로자퇴직급여 보장법 제18조(운용현황의 통지): '매년 1회 이상 적립금액 및 운용수익률 등을 … 가입자에게 알려야'. This article sits in the DB chapter; 제19조② applies it to DC.
- 제20조: 사용자 부담금 ≥ 가입자 연간 임금총액의 12분의 1, paid in cash, 매년 1회 이상 정기적으로 (③). Late payment adds 지연이자 (③). The member may pay 추가 부담금 (②). On retirement, assets can move to IRP (⑥⑦).
- 시행규칙 제7조: notice by 우편, 서면, 정보통신망 or an agreed method (①). For DC: '가입자별 적립금의 운용수익 및 운용방법별 구성비율 등의 운용현황' (②). Within 10 days if 부담금 is 1개월 이상 미납 or 수익률 changes sharply (④).
- 시행령 제32조①3 (DC 교육사항): 사용자의 부담금 수준, 납입시기 및 납입 현황; 운용방법별 수익구조, 매도기준가, 투자 위험 및 수수료.

Proposed manual-entry form:
(a) Snapshot: 기준일; 적립금 총평가액; 원리금보장 vs 실적배당 평가액; per-product rows (상품명, 평가금액, 수익률 as shown, 운용방법별 구성비율).
(b) Contributions: 입금일; 부담금 구분 (사용자부담금 / 가입자 추가부담금 / 지연이자 / 통산·이전입금); 금액.
(c) Optional: 기간 운용수익, 수수료 (운용관리/자산관리), and the reported 수익률 with its basis (누적/연환산, 기간).
Analogous real labels from the KIS pension CSV: 기본부담금, 통산부담금, 정기대기이자입금.

rate_limits:
- Files: none.
- KB OpenAPI: the official error-code page https://openapi.kbsec.com/errorcode_b2c lists:
  - E041 '서비스 호출 건수룰 초과 하였습니다.' (sic)
  - E042 '유량제어 정책을 확인해주세요.'
  - I435 '서비스 호출 건수를 초과하였습니다.'
  - I446 'API 사용 권한이 없습니다.'
  - I451 '유효하지 않은 앱키입니다.'
- Numeric limits are not published. The portal only says '호출 제한 초과: 일정 시간 후 재시도 또는 호출량 확인'. kr-broker (secondary) uses 400 ms between calls as a conservative guess.
caveats: KIS 거래종류 strings carry channel prefixes (HTS, Smart+, WTS) and sometimes a currency suffix ('해외증권매수 USD', seen only as a parser constant). Classify by suffix or substring ('…타사이체입금', '…당사이체출금', '배당금입금', 'ETF분배금입금', '예탁금이용료'), not exact match.

KIS export layouts differ:
- HTS .xls, 2-row paired: row A cols 0-8, row B cols 5/7/8 = 거래단가/정산금액/거래세.
- HTS .xls, single-row: cols 0..15.
- CSV with a 2-row header: 거래종류 at row 2 col 0.
- A CSV variant with 거래종류 at row 1 col 1.
Locate columns by header name, and find the header row by its first cell starting with '거래일'.

KIS '당사이체' (입금/출금/입고/출고) moves money or stock between KIS accounts, which may be the user's own. When summing flows across the user's accounts, net these out or match them against the counterpart. The 입출금거래내역 tab has 상대계좌/상대계좌명/상대금융기관 for this.
KIS '연금납입금전환' is NOT a cash flow: 잔액 does not change, 정산금액 = 0, and it follows a same-day 타사이체입금 of the identical amount (seen 4x across files). Count the 타사이체입금 only.

KIS income rows: 거래금액 = gross, 세금 = withholding, 정산금액 = net, and 잔액 moves by 정산금액. This is verified only on 예탁금이용료 (411/50/361 and 927/130/797). No ETF분배금입금 row with 세금 > 0 was seen (201 rows, all 세금 0). Use gross 거래금액 for yield. For buys, 정산금액 often differs from the cash impact: 잔액 fell by 거래금액 + 수수료 while 정산금액 was lower or 0. Use 잔액 deltas or 거래금액 ± 수수료 for trades.
KIS exports taken on different dates overlap (birdblues has 3 snapshots per account with identical rows). Deduplicate on (account, 거래일, 거래종류, 종목명, 거래금액, 잔액).
KIS: the homepage and HTS only list accounts with an 인터넷뱅킹 약정. Maximum 5 years per query; the HTS help says up to 10 years back.

Toss PDF parsing:
- The column header repeats on each page, and page-separator junk lines appear ('1111… ///// 2222…').
- USD rows are 2 lines, and the ISIN can wrap to line 2.
- Some 거래구분 are two tokens ('이벤트 입금', '대여료 입금', '대차거래 상환입고') or carry a bank suffix ('이체입금(카카오뱅크)').
- Numbers use thousands commas; USD has decimals.
- Text order depends on the extractor: thekanon's raw text interleaves '($ …)' values one per line and reorders header text ('2025XX04-105-11-RXXXXXX발급번호'). Parse with a layout-aware extractor (word coordinates), not naive line splits.

Toss external flows: 이체입금* and 이체출금* only (plus 오픈뱅킹입금 if it appears). Internal FX legs are 환전원화*/환전외화* and 환전외화입금취소. '이벤트 입금' is a promo credit: treat it as income or deposit by choice. '이체출금 토스페이' is spending (external outflow). '이체입금(토스증권)' may be from another own Toss account.
Toss 이체입금 rows can show 변제/연체합 when a deposit repays a tax shortfall created by 배당세출금 or 외화이자세금출금 (e.g. 4,000 in, 3,218 repaid, 잔액 782). The external deposit is still the full 거래대금.

Toss USD dividends: $거래대금 is what gets credited, and it is net of 15% US withholding. $제세금 is the US tax, so gross = 거래대금 + 제세금 (ratio 0.150-0.152 on 5 rows of one anonymized fixture). When $제세금 = 0, a same-day KRW 배당세출금 (~15.4%) carries the tax. Check against a real PDF before relying on this.
Toss domestic dividends: 거래대금 = gross, 제세금 = 15.4%, 잔액 += 거래대금 − 제세금. Tiny dividends can show 제세금 0 (소액부징수).

KB SWQA2301 values are fixed-width strings in mixed formats: comma-formatted and space-padded (dl_amt), zero-padded (ec_amt, tfnd_blnc), and decimals (fcrncy_amt '…00.00', exch_r '…0000'). Strip spaces and commas, and treat blank as 0/None. Sign and direction are not documented; derive direction from smry_nm, e.g. '입금' = smry_typ_cd 001 / dl_typ_cd 01 in the official sample.
KB OpenAPI account data may not be enabled for every app. kr-broker got I446 (API 사용 권한이 없습니다) on many account TRs with a real account, and SWQA2301 is 'spec-only' there (never live-verified).

Hana DC: 사용자부담금 is employer money, not the user's savings. For growth net of flows, count every 부담금 (사용자 and 가입자 추가) and 지연이자 as an external inflow on its 입금일. Otherwise growth is overstated.
